pli-tv-kd21:1.1.2: ekamidāhaṃ āvuso samayaṃ pāvāya kusināraṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.3: athakhvāhaṃ āvuso maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdiṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena aññataro ājīvako kusinārāyaṃ mandāravapupphaṃ gahetvā pāvaṃ addhānamaggapaṭipanno hoti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.5: addasaṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso taṃ ājīvakaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.11: tatrāvuso ye te bhikkhū avītarāgā appekacce bāhā paggayha kandanti chinnapādāva patanti āvaṭṭanti vivaṭṭanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.12: atikhippaṃ bhagavā parinibbuto atikhippaṃ sugato parinibbuto atikhippaṃ cakkhuṃ loke antarahitanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.13: ye pana te bhikkhū vītarāgā te satā sampajānā adhivāsenti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.19: sabbeheva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.20: taṃ kutettha āvuso labbhā yantaṃ jātaṃ bhūtaṃ saṅkhataṃ palokadhammaṃ taṃ vata mā palujjīti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.22: tena kho panāvuso samayena subhaddo nāma vuḍḍhapabbajito tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.23: athakho āvuso subhaddo vuḍḍhapabbajito te bhikkhū etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.28: idaṃ vo kappati idaṃ vo na kappatīti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.29: idāni pana mayaṃ yaṃ icchissāma taṃ karissāma yaṃ na icchissāma na taṃ karissāmāti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.30: handa mayaṃ āvuso dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyāma
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.33: pure adhammavādino balavanto honti dhammavādino dubbalā honti
pli-tv-kd21:1.1.34: avinayavādino balavanto honti vinayavādino dubbalā hontīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.2.4: ayaṃ bhante āyasmā ānando kiñcāpi sekkho samāno abhabbo chandā dosā mohā bhayā agatiṃ gantuṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.2.5: bahu canena bhagavato santike dhammo ca vinayo ca pariyatto
pli-tv-kd21:1.2.6: tenahi bhante thero āyasmantaṃpi ānandaṃ uccinātūti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.2.7: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃpi ānandaṃ uccini.
pli-tv-kd21:1.3.2: kattha nu kho mayaṃ dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyeyyāmāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.3.4: rājagahaṃ kho mahāgocaraṃ pahūtasenāsanaṃ yannūna mayaṃ rājagahe vassaṃ vasantā dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyeyyāma
pli-tv-kd21:1.3.5: na aññe bhikkhū rājagahe vassaṃ upagaccheyyunti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho imāni pañca bhikkhusatāni sammanneyya
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.4: rājagahe vassaṃ vasantāni dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyituṃ na aññehi bhikkhūhi rājagahe vassaṃ vasitabbanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.8: rājagahe vassaṃ vasantāni dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyituṃ na aññehi bhikkhūhi rājagahe vassaṃ vasitabbanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.9: yassāyasmato khamati imesaṃ pañcannaṃ bhikkhusatānaṃ sammati
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.10: rājagahe vassaṃ vasantānaṃ dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyituṃ na aññehi bhikkhūhi rājagahe vassaṃ vasitabbanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.13: sammatāni saṅghena imāni pañca bhikkhusatāni rājagahe vassaṃ vasantāni dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyituṃ na aññehi bhikkhūhi rājagahe vassaṃ vasitabbanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.4.14: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.5.1: athakho therā bhikkhū rājagahaṃ agamaṃsu dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyituṃ.
pli-tv-kd21:1.5.4: handa mayaṃ āvuso paṭhamaṃ māsaṃ khaṇḍaphullaṃ paṭisaṅkharoma
pli-tv-kd21:1.5.5: majjhimaṃ māsaṃ sannipatitvā dhammañca vinayañca saṅgāyissāmāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.5.6: athakho therā bhikkhū paṭhamaṃ māsaṃ khaṇḍaphullaṃ paṭisaṅkhariṃsu.
pli-tv-kd21:1.6.2: sve sannipāto na kho me taṃ paṭirūpaṃ yohaṃ sekkho samāno sannipātaṃ gaccheyyanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.6.3: bahudeva rattiṃ kāyagatāya satiyā vītināmetvā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ nipajjissāmīti kāyaṃ āvaṭṭesi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.6.4: appattañca sīsaṃ bimbohanaṃ. bhūmito ca pādā muttā.
pli-tv-kd21:1.6.5: etasmiṃ antare anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
pli-tv-kd21:1.6.6: athakho āyasmā ānando arahā samāno sannipātaṃ agamāsi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ upāliṃ vinayaṃ puccheyyanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ āyasmatā mahākassapena vinayaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.7: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.8: paṭhamaṃ āvuso upāli pārājikaṃ kattha paññattanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.14: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ paṭhamassa pārājikassa vatthumpi pucchi nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi paññattimpi pucchi anuppaññattimpi pucchi āpattimpi pucchi anāpattimpi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.21: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ dutiyassa pārājikassa vatthumpi pucchi nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi paññattimpi pucchi anuppaññattimpi pucchi āpattimpi pucchi anāpattimpi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.28: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ tatiyassa pārājikassa vatthumpi pucchi nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi paññattimpi pucchi anuppaññattimpi pucchi āpattimpi pucchi anāpattimpi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.7.35: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ catutthassa pārājikassa vatthumpi pucchi nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi paññattimpi pucchi anuppaññattimpi pucchi āpattimpi pucchi anāpattimpi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.3: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ ānandaṃ dhammaṃ puccheyyanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.6: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ ahaṃ āyasmatā mahākassapena dhammaṃ puṭṭho vissajjeyyanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.7: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.9: antarā ca bhante rājagahaṃ antarā ca nāḷandaṃ rājāgāre ambalaṭṭhikāyāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.12: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ brahmajālassa nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.8.17: athakho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ sāmaññaphalassa nidānampi pucchi puggalampi pucchi
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.1: athakho āyasmā ānando there bhikkhū etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.3: ākaṅkhamāno ānanda saṅgho mamaccayena khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhaneyyāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.4: pucchi pana tvaṃ āvuso ānanda bhagavantaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.9: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.11: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā terasa saṅghādisese ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.13: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā terasa saṅghādisese ṭhapetvā dve aniyate ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.15: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā terasa saṅghādisese ṭhapetvā dve aniyate ṭhapetvā tiṃsa nissaggiye pācittiye ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.17: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā terasa saṅghādisese ṭhapetvā dve aniyate ṭhapetvā tiṃsa nissaggiye pācittiye ṭhapetvā dvenavuti pācittiye ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.19: cattāri pārājikāni ṭhapetvā terasa saṅghādisese ṭhapetvā dve aniyate ṭhapetvā tiṃsa nissaggiye pācittiye ṭhapetvā dvenavuti pācittiye ṭhapetvā cattāro pāṭidesanīye ṭhapetvā avasesāni khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.24: idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati idaṃ vo na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.25: sace mayaṃ khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanissāma bhavissanti vattāro
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.26: dhūmakālikaṃ samaṇena gotamena sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.27: yāvimesaṃ satthā aṭṭhāsi tāvime sikkhāpadesu sikkhiṃsu
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.28: yato imesaṃ satthā parinibbuto nadānīme sikkhāpadesu sikkhantīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.29: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho appaññattaṃ na paññāpeyya paññattaṃ na samucchindeyya yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vatteyya.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.34: idaṃ vo samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtiyānaṃ kappati idaṃ vo na kappatīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.35: sace mayaṃ khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadāni samūhanissāma bhavissanti vattāro
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.36: dhūmakālikaṃ samaṇena gotamena sāvakānaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.37: yāvimesaṃ satthā aṭṭhāsi tāvime sikkhāpadesu sikkhiṃsu
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.38: yato imesaṃ satthā parinibbuto nadānīme sikkhāpadesu sikkhantīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.39: saṅgho appaññattaṃ na paññāpeti paññattaṃ na samucchindati yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattati.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.40: yassāyasmato khamati appaññattassa appaññāpanā paññattassa asamucchedo yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattanā so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.42: saṅgho appaññattaṃ na paññāpeti paññattaṃ na samucchindati yathāpaññattesu sikkhāpadesu samādāya vattati.
pli-tv-kd21:1.9.43: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.1: athakho therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.2: idante āvuso ānanda dukkaṭaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavantaṃ na pucchi katamāni pana bhante khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.4: ahaṃ kho bhante asatiyā bhagavantaṃ na pucchiṃ katamāni bhante khuddānukhuddakāni sikkhāpadānīti
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.5: nāhaṃ taṃ dukkaṭaṃ passāmi apicāyasmantānaṃ saddhāya desemi taṃ dukkaṭanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.6: idampi te āvuso ānanda dukkaṭaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavato vassikasāṭikaṃ akkamitvā sibbesi
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.8: ahaṃ kho bhante na agāravena bhagavato vassikasāṭikaṃ akkamitvā sibbesiṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.9: nāhantaṃ dukkaṭaṃ passāmi apicāyasmantānaṃ saddhāya desemi taṃ dukkaṭanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.10: idampi te āvuso ānanda dukkaṭaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ mātugāmehi bhagavato sarīraṃ paṭhamaṃ vandāpesi tāsaṃ rodantīnaṃ bhagavato sarīraṃ assukena makkhitaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.12: ahaṃ kho bhante māyimā vikāle ahesunti mātugāmehi bhagavato sarīraṃ paṭhamaṃ vandāpesiṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.13: nāhantaṃ dukkaṭaṃ passāmi apicāyasmantānaṃ saddhāya desemi taṃ dukkaṭanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.14: idampi te āvuso ānanda dukkaṭaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhagavatā oḷārike nimitte kariyamāne oḷārike obhāse kariyamāne na bhagavantaṃ yāci
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.15: tiṭṭhatu bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.17: ahaṃ kho bhante mārena pariyuṭṭhitacitto na bhagavantaṃ yāciṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.18: tiṭṭhatu bhagavā kappaṃ tiṭṭhatu sugato kappaṃ bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.19: nāhantaṃ dukkaṭaṃ passāmi apicāyasmantānaṃ saddhāya desemi taṃ dukkaṭanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.20: idampi te āvuso ānanda dukkaṭaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ ussukkaṃ akāsi
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.22: ahaṃ kho bhante ayaṃ mahāpajāpatī gotamī bhagavato mātucchā āpādikā posikā khīrassa dāyikā bhagavantaṃ janettiyā kālakatāya thaññaṃ pāyesīti mātugāmassa tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye pabbajjaṃ ussukkaṃ akāsiṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.10.23: nāhantaṃ dukkaṭaṃ passāmi apicāyasmantānaṃ saddhāya desemi taṃ dukkaṭanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā purāṇo dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.2: athakho āyasmā purāṇo therehi bhikkhūhi dhamme ca vinaye ca saṅgīte dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena rājagahaṃ veḷuvanaṃ kalandakanivāpo yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammoditvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ purāṇaṃ therā bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.4: therehi āvuso purāṇa dhammo ca vinayo ca saṅgīto
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.6: susaṅgītāvuso therehi bhikkhūhi dhammo ca vinayo ca
pli-tv-kd21:1.11.7: apica yatheva mayā bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ tathevāhaṃ dhāressāmīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.1: athakho āyasmā ānando there bhikkhū etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.3: tenahānanda saṅgho mamaccayena channassa bhikkhuno brahmadaṇḍaṃ āṇāpetūti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.4: pucchi pana tvaṃ āvuso ānanda bhagavantaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.8: channo ānanda bhikkhu yaṃ iccheyya taṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.9: bhikkhūhi channo bhikkhu neva vattabbo na ovaditabbo na anusāsitabboti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.10: tenahāvuso ānanda tvaṃyeva channassa bhikkhuno brahmadaṇḍaṃ āṇāpehīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.11: kathāhaṃ bhante channassa bhikkhuno brahmadaṇḍaṃ āṇāpemi caṇḍo so bhikkhu pharusoti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.12: tenahāvuso ānanda bahukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gacchāhīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.12.13: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi nāvāya gantvā kosambiṃ ujjavanikāya nāvāya paccorohitvā rañño udenassa uyyānassa avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.1: tena kho pana samayena rājā udeno uyyāne parivārehi saddhiṃ orodhena paṭivasati.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.3: amhākaṃ kira ācariyo ayyo ānando uyyānassa avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinnoti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.4: athakho rañño udenassa orodho rājānaṃ udenaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.5: amhākaṃ kira deva ācariyo ayyo ānando uyyānassa avidūre aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle nisinno
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.6: icchāma mayaṃ deva ayyaṃ ānandaṃ passitunti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.8: athakho rañño udenassa orodho yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.9: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rañño udenassa orodhaṃ āyasmā ānando dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.10: athakho rañño udenassa orodho āyasmatā ānandena dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito āyasmato ānandassa pañca uttarāsaṅgasatāni pādāsi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.13.11: athakho rañño udenassa orodho āyasmato ānandassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena rājā udeno tenupasaṅkami.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.1: addasā kho rājā udeno orodhaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.3: api nu kho tumhe samaṇaṃ ānandaṃ passathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.4: apassimhā kho mayaṃ deva ayyaṃ ānandanti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.5: apinu tumhe samaṇassa ānandassa kiñci adatthāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.6: adamhā kho mayaṃ deva ayyassa ānandassa pañca uttarāsaṅgasatānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.8: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇo ānando tāvabahuṃ cīvaraṃ paṭiggahessati
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.9: dussavaṇijjaṃ vā samaṇo ānando karissati paggāhikasālaṃ vā pasāressatīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.10: athakho rājā udeno yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā ānandena saddhiṃ sammodi
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.11: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.12: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā udeno āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.13: āgamā nu bho ānanda amhākaṃ orodhoti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.15: apica pana bhoto ānandassa kiñci adāsīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.16: adāsi kho me mahārāja pañca uttarāsaṅgasatānīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.17: kiṃ pana bhavaṃ ānando tāvabahuṃ cīvaraṃ karissatīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.18: ye te mahārāja bhikkhū dubbalacīvarā tehi saddhiṃ saṃvibhajissāmīti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.19: yāni kho pana bho ānanda porāṇakāni dubbalacīvarāni tāni kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.21: yāni pana bho ānanda porāṇakāni uttarattharaṇāni tāni kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.23: yā pana bho ānanda porāṇakā bhisicchaviyo tā kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.25: yāni pana bho ānanda porāṇakāni bhummattharaṇāni tāni kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.27: yā pana bho ānanda porāṇakā pādapuñchaniyo tā kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.29: yāni pana bho ānanda porāṇakāni rajoharaṇāni tāni kathaṃ karissathāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.30: tāni mahārāja koṭṭetvā cikkhallena madditvā paribhaṇḍaṃ limpissāmāti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.31: athakho rājā udeno sabbe vime samaṇā sakyaputtiyā yoniso upanenti na kulavaṃ gamentīti
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.32: āyasmato ānandassa aññānipi pañca dussasatāni pādāsi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.14.33: ayañcarahi āyasmato ānandassa paṭhamaṃ cīvaraparikkhāro uppajji cīvarasahassaṃ.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yena ghositārāmo tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.2: athakho āyasmā channo yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.3: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ channaṃ āyasmā ānando etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.4: saṅghena te āvuso channa brahmadaṇḍo āṇattoti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.6: tvaṃ āvuso channa bhikkhu yaṃ iccheyyāsi taṃ vadeyyāsi
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.7: bhikkhūhi tvaṃ neva vattabbo na ovaditabbo nānusāsitabboti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.8: nanvāhaṃ bhante ānanda hato ettāvatā yatohaṃ bhikkhūhi neva vattabbo na ovaditabbo nānusāsitabboti tattheva mucchito papati.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.9: athakho āyasmā channo brahmadaṇḍena aṭṭiyamāno harāyamāno jigucchamāno eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto nacirasseva
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.10: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.11: brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.12: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.13: aññataro ca panāyasmā channo arahataṃ ahosi.
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.14: athakho āyasmā channo arahattaṃ patto yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
pli-tv-kd21:1.15.16: yadaggena tayā āvuso channa arahattaṃ sacchikataṃ tadaggena te brahmadaṇḍo paṭippassaddhoti.
pli-tv-kd21:1.16.1: imāya kho pana vinayasaṅgītiyā pañca bhikkhusatāni anūnāni anadhikāni ahesuṃ.
pli-tv-kd21:1.16.3: pañcasatikakkhandhakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ ekādasamaṃ. imamhi khandhake vatthū tevīsati.
